ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's safety complaint; preserve the in-app chat (17:09:35 rider "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." / 17:10:30 driver "Sit down or I lock the doors.") and the driver's statement; do not execute any refund on this ticket until a human reviewer rules; route the rider to RydeHELP to file the incident report (995 / driver's commercial motor insurance if medical assistance is needed).
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen first (SAFE-1/SAFE-2) and the dispute type itself is safety, so no automatic ruling may issue. The rider's complaint states the driver "threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out"; the chat corroborates the sequence: at 17:09:35 (trip in progress — pickup 17:08:00, dropoff 17:31:40) the rider wrote "Please stop the car, I want to get out here.", and at 17:10:30 the driver replied "Sit down or I lock the doors." A locking threat issued after an express request to exit is, read in context, intimidation aimed at the other party, and the driver's own statement confirms he overrode the request ("I told her to sit down ... and drove on"). That engages SAFE-1 (threats/intimidation/abuse) and, given the rider reports feeling unsafe for the whole ride, the incident also falls to be handled under SAFE-2 (passenger kept in a moving vehicle against her expressed wish). Per rule, the escalation summary is the factual account of the chat, complaint and driver statement, plus the reporting paths (RydeHELP; 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance for medical claims). Nothing is computed for the fare side: no refund is determined here because the safety screen bars an automatic ruling. The GPS trace and quoted route do not settle the safety question, and no detour audit is needed since the dispute is not a route-deviation claim; the fare shown (SGD 32.86, RydeX fixed pricing) is left untouched pending human review. The driver's profile (4.62 rating, 0 upheld disputes in 90 days) does not bear on the safety finding and is not used to decide anything. Evidence for the safety determination is sufficient — both parties' words and the timed chat are on record and the GPS trace covers the whole trip window — so evidence_status = sufficient; the escalation is on the merits of the safety screen, not on missing records.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety-type dispute with a credible threat/intimidation allegation: the driver told the rider "Sit down or I lock the doors." after she asked to get out, and his own statement confirms he kept driving. SAFE-1/SAFE-2 require a human reviewer; no automated refund or fee decision may issue.
safety_basis: Rider complaint: 'The driver threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out. I felt unsafe for the whole ride.'
Chat 17:09:35 rider: 'Please stop the car, I want to get out here.'
Chat 17:10:30 driver: 'Sit down or I lock the doors.'

Driver statement: 'The rider tried to open the door at the lights. I told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on.' — driver's own account confirms he refused a request to stop and kept the rider in the moving vehicle after issuing a locking threat.
